case_title: BOWEN RICHARD et al VS QUINTILIANI PATRICIA

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $5,000.00 FILED BY BOWEN RICHARD BOWEN SUSAN AS TO DEFENDANT QUINTILIANI PATRICIA ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR AUG-07-1992 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 05
